full_judgment:
Mr. A.K.M. Shahidul Huq, J:- The judgment of reversal has been called in question by invoking the revisional jurisdiction of this Hon'ble Court as laid down in section 115(1) of the Code of Civil Procedure on laying an application under section 115(1) of the Code of Civil Procedure in which a single Judge of this Hon'ble Court on perusal of the impugned judgment and decree of reversal dated 30.04.2001 passed by the learned Subordinate Judge court No. 2 Lalmonirhat in other appeal No. 28 of 2000 was pleased to issue a rule calling upon the opposite parties to show cause as to why the judgment and decree dated 30.04.2001 passed by the learned Subordinate Judge. Court No. 2 Lalmonirhat in Other Appeal No.28 of 2000 allowing the appeal and thereby reversing the judgment and decree dated 24.04.2000 passed by the Senior Assistant Judge Lalmonirhat in Other Suit No.6 of 2000 should not be set aside and or pass such other or further order or orders as to this Court may seem fit and proper. 

 17. I also find the impugned judgment of the last court of fact has been passed in total non-consideration of both oral and documentary evidence on record as such the same has suffered from serious legal perversity material irregularity non consideration of both oral and documentary evidence in its true perspective and as such the learned judge passed the impugned judgment and decree in violation of the mandatory provisions of law as contain in section 115(1) of the Code of Civil Procedure as because the impugned judgment is not a proper judgment of reversal based on due and proper consideration of both oral and documentary evidence on record and as such the same cannot be sustainable under any provisions of law as contain in section 115(1) of the Code of Civil Procedure and consequently the impugned judgment and decree of last court of fact deserves my interference under the revisional jurisdiction of this Hon'ble Court as laid down in section 115(1) of the Code of Civil Procedure.
